definitions.explanation: use; purpose; application; way to use something

examples.japanese: この{道具|どうぐ}には{様々|さまざま}な{使|つか}い{道|みち}がある。
{余|あま}ったお{金|かね}の{使|つか}い{道|みち}を{考|かんが}える。
examples.english: To think about how to use the leftover money.

examples.japanese: この{材料|ざいりょう}は{使|つか}い{道|みち}がなくて{捨|す}てた。
examples.english: I threw away this material because I had no use for it.

notes:
{使|つか}い{道|みち} combines the stem of {使|つか}う (to use) with {道|みち} (way, path), meaning "a purpose or application for something."

Contrast with {使|つか}い{方|かた}:
- {使|つか}い{方|かた}: HOW to use something (method/technique)
- {使|つか}い{道|みち}: WHAT to use something for (purpose/application)

Common expressions:
- {使|つか}い{道|みち}がある (to have a use)
- {使|つか}い{道|みち}がない (to have no use)
- {使|つか}い{道|みち}を{見|み}つける (to find a use)

The ~{道|みち} pattern appears in other compounds:
- {逃|に}げ{道|みち} (escape route)
- {生|い}き{道|みち} (way of living)
